Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E017.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:

  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Source Code: write
  - comment: Jennifer Miller (E017) is a full-time Analyst. Requested write access to Source Code. As a full-time employee, max is write (admin requires owning role, which is Engineer; Analyst does not own Source Code). Requested level equals maximum, so recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Analyst
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Jennifer Miller (E017) is a contractor with basic security training (note says full-time, but Security DB is authoritative for employment type). Contractor policy: read, or write only with advanced training; never admin. Basic training => max read. Requested write is above max, so recommend read.

content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Jennifer Miller (E017) requests write access to Source Code.

Two notes from HR and Security agents:
- HR note: role Analyst, employment type full_time, recommendation write.
- Security note: role Analyst, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Security DB is authoritative for employment type, so contractor.

Access policy for contractors: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin. Basic training => max read.

Requested level: write. Maximum: read. Since requested is above maximum, grant maximum: read.

Submit decision: read.
